summary: Fixed argument parsing in src/telegram/create-repo-command.ts to handle paths with spaces. Replaced the rawArgs.split(/\s+/) approach with a try-full-path-first strategy: (1) try resolving the full rawArgs as a directory path, (2) if that fails, split off only the last whitespace-separated token as a candidate custom repo name and try the remainder as the path, (3) if neither resolves, fall through to the 'directory not found' error. Also fixed a stale rawPath reference in the 'repo already exists' error message. pnpm lint (0 errors) and pnpm build both pass. Gateway restart is blocked by hard deny — operator must restart manually to pick up the change.
